technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum weak; price below key MAs with MACD bearish divergence and death cross; volume spike and squeeze setup offer potential but lack confluence with momentum confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar pressures multinationals, with earnings event in 48 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (supertrend, EMA 50/200, Ichimoku) is bullish with volume spike and squeeze setup offering potential breakout, while extreme fear (19/100) and contrarian congressional buying present asymmetric risk/reward in a capitulation environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is trapped below all key short-term moving averages (EMA 9/21 death cross), MACD shows bearish divergence, momentum is weak (RSI 36-41, no trend strength via ADX 12.94), macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), and earnings binary risk in 48 days negates any technical setup.
